User Authentication and Management System
This system is designed to manage and authenticate users while tracking their interactions with various services and worker nodes in the system. The key functionalities of the system are:
1.User Registration and Management:
Store user registration information, including username, full name, email, password hash, registration date, and last login date.
Ensure the uniqueness of usernames and email addresses.
2.User Authentication:
Store information of authenticated users, including username, full name, authentication level (ring), and authentication time.
Ensure the uniqueness of authenticated usernames.
Record signatures and issuer information during the authentication process.
3.User Migration:
Track user migrations from an old system to the new system, recording the old and new user IDs, along with the migration time.
4.Authenticated Consumer Management:
Store information of authenticated consumers, including name, description, type, and associated user ID.
Store configuration data,permissions, and signatures for each consumer.
5.Session Management:
Store session information, including session ID, associated consumer ID, expiration time, and MFA (Multi-Factor Authentication) status.
Record session signatures and issuer information.
6.Service Management:
Store information of various services in the system, including service name, type, URL, and configuration.
Track the last heartbeat time and monitoring status of services.
Record service signatures and issuer information.
7.Worker Node Management:
Store information of worker nodes, including node name, status, associated service ID, operating system, architecture, and last heartbeat time.
Record worker node signatures and issuer information.
Each service contains multiple worker nodes, each user may have multiple authenticated consumers, and each consumer will have multiple sessions.

-- Schema for database: rschema_0121

CREATE TABLE users (
  id INT(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  username VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  full_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  password_hash VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  registration_date DATETIME NOT NULL,
  last_login_date DATETIME NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  UNIQUE KEY username (username),
  UNIQUE KEY email (email)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE user_registrations (
  id INT(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  user_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  registration_date DATETIME NOT NULL,
  last_login_date DATETIME NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE user_authentications (
  id INT(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  user_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  authentication_level VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  authentication_time DATETIME NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE user_migrations (
  id INT(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  old_user_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  new_user_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  migration_time DATETIME NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  FOREIGN KEY (old_user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (new_user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE authenticated_consumers (
  id INT(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  user_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  description VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  type VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE consumer_configurations (
  id INT(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  consumer_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  configuration VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  permissions VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  FOREIGN KEY (consumer_id) REFERENCES authenticated_consumers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE sessions (
  id INT(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  consumer_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  expiration_time DATETIME NOT NULL,
  mfa_status VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  FOREIGN KEY (consumer_id) REFERENCES authenticated_consumers (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE services (
  id INT(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  type VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  url VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  configuration VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  last_heartbeat_time DATETIME NOT NULL,
  monitoring_status VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;

CREATE TABLE worker_nodes (
  id INT(11) NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  service_id INT(11) NOT NULL,
  node_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  status VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  operating_system VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  architecture VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  last_heartbeat_time DATETIME NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (id),
  FOREIGN KEY (service_id) REFERENCES services (id) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb3;
